name: Arnacon
description: Proposed MCP tools for an already-created Arnacon identity. Talk as an email or a new identity — a phone number is not required. This file is a spec on the GitHub Pages preview. A live mcp.arnacon.com server is not up yet.

auth.requirement: The connected user must already hold an Arnacon identity in the native app. Never expose a mnemonic or private key. Payments and store checkout stay human. installProduct requires an explicit Allow from the user. WhatsApp is out of scope.

never: installProduct without an explicit user Allow

tools.name: resolveIdentity
tools.description: Resolve an Arnacon identity name (for example alice.arnacon.global) to its owner. Read-only.

identity.description: Identity to resolve, such as alice.arnacon.global or you@mail.com

tools.name: listIdentities
tools.description: List identities installed for the signed-in user. Read-only.

tools.name: getProviderInfo
tools.description: Read-only provider metadata for the current identity. Never returns keys.

tools.name: supportedNotificationTypes
tools.description: Read-only list of notification types this identity can send (call and/or message).

tools.name: sendMessage
tools.description: Send a message from an identity the user already owns to another identity or email. Maps to prepareNotification(.message) then executeNotification. Requires confirmation. Never send as someone else.

from.description: Sender identity the user already owns

to.description: Recipient identity or email — a phone number is not required

tools.name: startCall
tools.description: Start a call from an identity the user already owns to another identity or email. Maps to sendCallNotification / prepareNotification(.call). Requires confirmation. A phone number is not required.

fromIdentity.description: Caller identity the user already owns

toIdentity.description: Callee identity or email — a phone number is not required
